audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-5 read Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Skill / Skill / Poppy while every why under them said the row was yours.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Poppy] at 51.8%, and the mirror flipped its rows 4-6 for the same reason. Poppy's damage arrives with tank items; your max-health bite does not wait for them.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4, 5 to Warwick and row 1 to Skill on both layers as matched pairs, ratings adjusted, row 6 left with Poppy.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike treated Keeper's Verdict as the thing that stops your engage.
audit.why: The real gate is Steadfast Presence (W, 20/18/16/14/12s): it stops enemy dashes around her and grounds and slows whatever it catches — that hits both Jaws of the Beast and the Infinite Duress leap. Keeper's Verdict is a 140s channel she rarely holds for you in lane.
audit.corrected: Spike rebuilt around spending her W first, with Heroic Charge's 14-10s attached to the level 3-5 window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Warwick was again credited with a 'Q reset', and the page never named the dash-denial that decides the matchup.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast is a 365-range lunge. Poppy's W is the counter to it and to your ultimate; her E stuns only when it pushes you into a wall, which is why terrain choice is a real decision here. Primal Howl's 1s fear can break her Keeper's Verdict channel, which is flagged interruptible.
audit.corrected: Removed the false reset, named Steadfast Presence with its cooldown, and kept the wall rule concrete.

edits.before: W attack speed turns on against low-HP targets. Only take the trade when Poppy's Heroic Charge is down.
edits.after: Blood Hunt only turns on below 50% health, so level 2 is even — and never stand near a wall for Heroic Charge.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Poppy must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — Hammer Shock's zone slows you, so bite after it explodes and let Eternal Hunger carry the extended trade.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Poppy's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s, but Steadfast Presence stops the leap outright — ult only after her W is spent. Keeper's Verdict is 140s.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: Q reset and Blood Hunt speed out-trade her weak early kit.
edits.after: Level 3 favours you: Jaws' max-health bite out-trades her weak early kit.

edits.before: Your Q heal and Blood Hunt speed win extended trades before Poppy is tanky; bait her Heroic Charge so she can't pin you to a wall for the stun.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast heals for damage dealt and wins extended trades before Poppy is tanky; bait Heroic Charge (14-10s) so she cannot pin you to a wall.

edits.before: Infinite Duress locks Poppy down and bursts her — just be ready for her to Keeper's Verdict cancel your engage; all-in when her W and R are down.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence (20s at rank 1) stops dashes around her, killing both Jaws and your leap — all-in only once she has spent it, then suppress for 1.5s.

edits.before: Levels 3 to 6 firmly favour you: your Q reset and W speed win every trade before she stacks armor, and Infinite Duress at 6 bursts her; just avoid walls so Heroic Charge can't pin and stun you.
edits.after: Levels 3 to 6 firmly favour you: Jaws' max-health bite beats her before she stacks armour, and at 6 you suppress her for 1.5s; stay off walls for Heroic Charge and watch her W.

edits.before: Q-bite Poppy as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Poppy once Steadfast Presence is spent, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her return damage.

edits.before: Q-bite Poppy as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Poppy once Steadfast Presence is spent, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal her return damage.

notes: Hammer Shock carries a derived grounding flag that Riot's description does not support (slow and a delayed explosion only), so no grounding claim was written for her Q — the real dash denial is Steadfast Presence, which Riot's text states outright. Full layer calls Poppy 'he' in several inherited strings. Brief games=347 vs packet games=334.
